# Filter points based on pairwise distance
def filter_points(points):
    valid_points = []
    for i in range(len(points)):
        is_valid = True
        for j in range(len(valid_points)):
            dist = np.linalg.norm(points[i] - valid_points[j])
            if dist <= np.linalg.norm(points[i]):  # Ensure pairwise distance > max norm
                is_valid = False
                break
        if is_valid:
            valid_points.append(points[i])
    return np.array(valid_points)

filtered_points = filter_points(points)
return filtered_points
